dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature (falcate) from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the terminal point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin incline, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height is approximately equal to the horizontal base width, creating a 1:1 ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex, semi-hemispherical arc curvature characterizing the anterior-dorsal melon boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Visible beak length is approximately 30 percent of the longitudinal melon diameter, with thickness nearly equivalent to its length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse interior angle at the pixel junction where the melon's descending slope meets the horizontal rostrum base.
